recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If future work changes the externally hosted $merge operation, review the Admin Incubator operation source, but no current FHIR core source edit is needed for FHIR-17487.
issue_request: FHIR-17487 was a Published/Persuasive PA request raised against STU3 Patient asking that the Patient merge STU consideration include how linking and merging affect Patient compartment membership.
initial_application: The seed key does not appear in source history, but the related GF#16429 merge-note update applied the requested wording: commit 9f6368a72b changed the old Patient merge STU note to a generic note and added the explicit question, "How will the patient compartment interact with the merge?"
additional_context: The old generic Patient merge note was later superseded by R5 Patient merge/link work. FHIR-15837, which FHIR-17487 was filed while reviewing, was later Published/Persuasive and commit 7001897476 placed the exact linked-versus-merged Patient compartment guidance into source/compartments.xml. Current Patient narrative introduces merging/linking and points $merge to the Admin Incubator operation; FHIR-19687 is a later merge/link search-behavior decision already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active compartment source states that linked Patient records require separate compartment searches, while merged patients should move associated resources to the target patient so the target compartment includes the relevant data and the source compartment contains only the linked Patient plus possible remnants such as AuditEvent.
